ui.kagemura_is_played_by_people_of_many_.en: Kagemura is played by people of many ages, so we ask everyone's age before online play and protect younger players (players under 13 chat with ready-made messages only and cannot be found by name). Be respectful: no harassment, hate, threats, sexual content, or sharing anyone's personal details (including your own). No cheating or selling accounts. Use ⋯ to report or block anyone breaking the rules; staff can remove messages, mute chat and suspend accounts. The full rules are in Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.kagemura_is_played_by_people_of_many_.text: Kagemura በብዙ የዕድሜ ክልሎች ባሉ ሰዎች ይጫወታል፣ ስለዚህ ከመስመር ላይ ጨዋታ በፊት የሁሉንም ሰው ዕድሜ እንጠይቃለን፣ ትናንሽ ተጫዋቾችንም እንጠብቃለን (ከ13 ዓመት በታች ያሉ ተጫዋቾች በተዘጋጁ መልእክቶች ብቻ ይወያያሉ፣ በስምም ሊገኙ አይችሉም)። አክብሮት ያሳዩ፦ ትንኮሳ፣ ጥላቻ፣ ዛቻ፣ ወሲባዊ ይዘት ወይም የማንንም ግላዊ መረጃ (የራስዎንም ጨምሮ) ማጋራት የለም። ማጭበርበር ወይም መለያ መሸጥ የለም። ደንቦቹን የሚጥስን ማንኛውንም ሰው ሪፖርት ለማድረግ ወይም ለማገድ ⋯ን ይጠቀሙ፤ ሠራተኞች መልእክቶችን ማስወገድ፣ ውይይትን ማቆምና መለያዎችን ማገድ ይችላሉ። ሙሉ ደንቦቹ በቅንብሮች → ግላዊነትና እገዛ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።

ui.suggest_a_break_after_an_hour_of_play.en: Suggest a break after an hour of play

ui.switching_servers_restarts_the_game_y.text: አገልጋይ መቀየር ጨዋታውን እንደገና ያስጀምራል። በየትኛውም መንገድ መንደርዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ይቆያል።

ui.tactic_send_saboteurs_first_to_jam_de.en: Tactic: send Saboteurs first to jam defenses, then the main force; throw smoke over your warriors as they walk into tower range.
ui.tactic_send_saboteurs_first_to_jam_de.text: ስልት፦ መከላከያዎችን ለማሽመድመድ መጀመሪያ አሻጥረኞችን ይላኩ፣ ከዚያ ዋናውን ኃይል፤ ተዋጊዎችዎ ወደ ማማ ክልል ሲገቡ ጭስ ይጣሉባቸው።

ui.tap_inside_a_glowing_ring_to_send_you.en: Tap inside a glowing ring to send your warriors in. Arrows at the edge lead to more rings.
ui.tap_inside_a_glowing_ring_to_send_you.text: ተዋጊዎችዎን ለማስገባት በሚያበራ ቀለበት ውስጥ ይንኩ። በጠርዙ ላይ ያሉ ቀስቶች ወደ ተጨማሪ ቀለበቶች ይመራሉ።

ui.tap_on_the_grass_outside_the_red_area.en: Tap on the grass outside the red area to send your warriors in.
ui.tap_on_the_grass_outside_the_red_area.text: ተዋጊዎችዎን ለማስገባት ከቀዩ ቦታ ውጭ ያለውን ሣር ይንኩ።

ui.tap_update_to_get_the_newest_version_.en: Tap Update to get the newest version. You can also copy a save code to open the village on another device.
ui.tap_update_to_get_the_newest_version_.text: አዲሱን ስሪት ለማግኘት «ያዘምኑ»ን ይንኩ። መንደሩን በሌላ መሣሪያ ላይ ለመክፈት የቁጠባ ኮድም መቅዳት ይችላሉ።

ui.tap_where_your_warriors_are_about_to_.en: Tap where your warriors are about to come under fire: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
ui.tap_where_your_warriors_are_about_to_.text: ተዋጊዎችዎ ተኩስ ሊደርስባቸው ባለበት ቦታ ይንኩ፦ በጭሱ ውስጥ ያሉ ተዋጊዎች ሊመቱ የሚችሉት ከቅርብ ብቻ ነው።

ui.testing_sandbox_a_separate_practice_v.en: Testing sandbox: a separate practice village with testing tools and a free test store. Your real village is untouched, and online play is off.
ui.testing_sandbox_a_separate_practice_v.text: የሙከራ ማጠሪያ፦ የሙከራ መሣሪያዎችና ነፃ የሙከራ መደብር ያለው የተለየ የልምምድ መንደር። እውነተኛ መንደርዎ አይነካም፣ የመስመር ላይ ጨዋታም ጠፍቷል።

ui.that_path_is_full_each_point_hides_sp.text: ያ መንገድ ሞልቷል፦ እያንዳንዱ ነጥብ {arg1} የተዋጊ ቦታ ይደብቃል። ሌላ ነጥብ ይጠቀሙ።

ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.en: The Home Screen app keeps its own village, apart from Safari’s. To bring yours here: open Kagemura in Safari, go to Settings → Copy save code, then come back and use Settings → Load from code.
ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.text: የመነሻ ማያ መተግበሪያው ከSafari የተለየ የራሱን መንደር ይይዛል። የእርስዎን እዚህ ለማምጣት፦ Kagemuraን በSafari ይክፈቱ፣ ወደ ቅንብሮች → የቁጠባ ኮዱን ይቅዱ ይሂዱ፣ ከዚያ ተመልሰው ቅንብሮች → ከኮድ ይጫኑን ይጠቀሙ።

ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.en: The item is delivered at once; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.text: ዕቃው ወዲያውኑ ይደርሳል፤ በመግዛትዎ፣ ሕጉ ለዲጂታል ይዘት እንደሚፈቅደው፣ የመሰረዝ መብትዎን እንደሚያጡ ይስማማሉ።

ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.en: The new version could not be downloaded right now. Check your connection and try again.
ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.text: አዲሱ ስሪት አሁን ሊወርድ አልቻለም። ግንኙነትዎን ያረጋግጡና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.en: The next Alliance War starts in {arg1} and lasts {arg2} days. Every member gets {arg3} attacks; the best stars on each enemy base add up, and the Alliance with more stars wins.
ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.text: ቀጣዩ የኅብረት ጦርነት ለመጀመር {arg1} ቀርቶታል፣ {arg2} ቀናትም ይቆያል። እያንዳንዱ አባል {arg3} ጥቃቶች ያገኛል፤ በእያንዳንዱ የጠላት መንደር ላይ ያሉ ምርጥ ኮከቦች ይደመራሉ፣ ብዙ ኮከብ ያለው ኅብረትም ያሸንፋል።

ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.en: The raider held. This rematch is used up.
ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.text: ወራሪውን ማሸነፍ አልተቻለም። ይህን ድጋሚ ግጥሚያ ተጠቅመውበታል።

ui.the_server_did_not_accept_your_raid_o.text: አገልጋዩ ወረራዎን አልተቀበለም፦ {arg1}። እንደ ልምምድ ይቆጠራል፦ ምርኮም ክብርም የለም።{arg2}

ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.en: The Squad Courtyards are spoken for: train ahead for the next army

ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.en: The store could not be reached for prices. Check your connection and open the Store again.
ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.text: ዋጋዎችን ለማግኘት መደብሩን ማግኘት አልተቻለም። ግንኙነትዎን ያረጋግጡና መደብሩን እንደገና ይክፈቱ።

ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.en: Their full training cost comes back, as far as your storage allows.
ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.text: ማከማቻዎ እስከሚፈቅደው ድረስ ሙሉ የሥልጠና ወጪያቸው ይመለሳል።

ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.en: There is no online account on this device: your village is kept only here. "Start a new village" below erases it; uninstalling the app or clearing this site's data removes it completely.
ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.text: በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ የመስመር ላይ መለያ የለም፦ መንደርዎ የሚቀመጠው እዚህ ብቻ ነው። ከታች ያለው «አዲስ መንደር ይጀምሩ» ያጠፋዋል፤ መተግበሪያውን ማራገፍ ወይም የዚህን ጣቢያ መረጃ ማጽዳት ሙሉ በሙሉ ያስወግደዋል።

ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.en: They are under fire! Pick the Smoke Bomb, then tap on your warriors.
ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: ተኩስ እየደረሰባቸው ነው! የጭስ ቦምቡን ይምረጡ፣ ከዚያ ተዋጊዎችዎን ይንኩ።

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: በቀጣዩ ጥቃትዎ መጀመሪያ ይዋጋሉ፣ የአደባባይ ቦታም አይዙም።

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: ለዘለቄታው ወደ ቤታቸው ይሄዳሉ። ማከማቻዎ እስከሚፈቅደው ድረስ ከሥልጠና ወጪያቸው {arg1}% ይመለስልዎታል።

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} ከወረራ በኋላ ወይም ተዋጊዎችን ሲያሰናብቱ በራሳቸው ይገባሉ።

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: መጋበዝና የቡድን ጦርነቶችን መጀመር ይችላሉ። እርስዎ በቡድኑ ውስጥ ይቆያሉ።

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: ይህ አሳሽ መንደርዎን ማስቀመጥ አይችልም፦ ይህ ገጽ ሲዘጋ እድገቱ ይጠፋል። መደበኛ (የግል ያልሆነ) መስኮት ይጠቀሙ፣ ወይም በቅንብሮች ውስጥ የቁጠባ ኮድ ይቅዱ።

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ከቀሩ ይህ አሳሽ ይህን መንደር ሊሰርዘው ይችላል። ለማቆየት፦ Kagemuraን ይጫኑ (የአሳሹ ምናሌ → Install app ወይም Add to Home screen)፣ በየመስመር ላይ ጨዋታ ስር መግቢያ ያገናኙ፣ ወይም የቁጠባ ኮድ ይቅዱ።

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: ለአንድ ሳምንት ከቀሩ ይህ አሳሽ መንደርዎን ሊሰርዘው ይችላል።

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: ይህ የአሳሽ ሁኔታ ማስቀመጥ አይችልም። ገጹን ሲዘጉ መንደርዎ ይጠፋል።

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: ይህ መሣሪያ የቅርብ ጊዜ ድርጊቶችዎን ማከማቸት አልቻለም (ማከማቻው ሞልቷል ወይም ታግዷል)። አሁን ወደ አገልጋዩ እየተላኩ ነው፤ ከመስመር ውጭ በደህና መጫወት ለመቀጠል ጥቂት ቦታ ያስለቅቁ።

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: ይህ መሣሪያ አሁንም የመስመር ላይ መለያዎን ይዟል፣ በዚህ ላይ፦

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: ይህ መሣሪያ ከዚያ መግቢያ ጋር የተገናኘውን መለያ ይጫወታል። መንደሩ በአገልጋዩ ላይ የተቀመጠ ከሆነ፣ እዚህ ያለውን መንደር ይተካል፣ ያም በቅንብሮች ውስጥ እንደ ምትኬ ይቆያል። የአሁኑ የመስመር ላይ መለያዎ አይሰረዝም።

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: ይህ ለሙከራ የሆነ አገልጋይ ነው ({arg1})፦ እዚህ ያሉ መንደሮችና ግዢዎች ከእውነተኛው ጨዋታ የተለዩ ናቸው።

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: ይህ የሙከራ ማጠሪያ ነው፦ የመስመር ላይ ጨዋታ የጠፋበት የተለየ የልምምድ መንደር። ጊዜ መዝለል የማጠሪያውን ሰዓት ለዘለቄታው ወደፊት ያንቀሳቅሳል፤ እውነተኛ መንደርዎ ፈጽሞ አይነካም።

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: ይህ በአገልጋዩ ላይ የሚቀመጥ አዲስ መንደር ይጀምራል። በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ያለው መንደር በቅንብሮች ውስጥ ሊመልሱት የሚችሉት ምትኬ ሆኖ ይቆያል።

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: የጊዜ ዝላይዎችና የሙከራ ግዢዎች በተለየ የሙከራ ማጠሪያ ውስጥ ናቸው፣ ስለዚህ እውነተኛ መንደርዎን ወይም የመስመር ላይ ጨዋታዎን ፈጽሞ ሊቀይሩ አይችሉም።

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: በጓድ አደባባዮቹ ውስጥ የሚገጥሙት ሁሉ እስኪጨርሱ ያለው ጊዜ

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: መጀመሪያ ጥቂት ተዋጊዎችን ያሠልጥኑ፦ ግጥሚያዎች ሠራዊትዎን ይጠቀማሉ (ማንም አይጠፋም)።

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: ጥቂት ተዋጊዎችን ያሠልጥኑ፣ ከዚያ በኋላ እንደገና ለመሙላት ቅንጅቱን እዚህ ያስቀምጡ።

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: አስቀድሞ የሠለጠኑ። የጓድ አደባባዮቹ ቦታ ሲኖራቸው ሠራዊትዎን ይቀላቀላሉ። እስከዚያው ጄድ ሊጨርሳቸው አይችልም።

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: ከሁለት እስከ አራት ጓደኞች ተመሳሳይ መጠን ካለው ሌላ ቡድን ጋር፦ ለመዘጋጀት 2 ሰዓት፣ ከዚያ ለእያንዳንዱ 2 ጥቃቶች ያሉት 22 ሰዓት። ብቻዎን ይምቱ፣ ወይም በቅብብል፦ የቅብብል ምት የሚጀምረው ቡድንዎ በዚያ መንደር ላይ ካደረሰው የመጨረሻ ምት ጉዳት ግማሽ ነው (ተከላካዮች በመካከል ይጠግናሉ)። ምንም ክብር አይገኝም አይጠፋም፤ ሁሉም ሣጥን ያገኛል።

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: ወቅቱ እስኪያበቃ ድረስ፦ {pct}% ፈጣን ግንባታዎች፣ «{arg1}» ገጽታና በእያንዳንዱ እርከን ትልልቅ ሽልማቶች። አስቀድመው ያገኟቸው ሽልማቶች ወዲያውኑ ይከፈታሉ።

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: Kagemuraን ከዚህ ያዘምኑ፦ {arg1}፣ ከዚያ እንደገና ይክፈቱት።

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:
ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.text: የጎሳ ምሽግዎን ወደ ደረጃ {arg1} ማሻሻል የሚከፍታቸው፦

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: የመንደር ካርታ። ዙሪያውን ለማየት ይጎትቱ፣ ለማጉላት ይቆንጥጡ ወይም ያሸብልሉ፣ ሕንፃን ለመምረጥ ይንኩት። እያንዳንዱ ድርጊት በካርታው ዙሪያ ባሉ ቁልፎች ላይም አለ።

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: ተዋጊዎች ሁለት ሕንፃዎች ያስፈልጋቸዋል፦ ዶጆው ያሠለጥናቸዋል፣ አደባባዩ ያስተናግዳቸዋል።

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: በዚህ መሣሪያና በአገልጋያችን ላይ የምናስቀምጠው የዕድሜ ክልልን ብቻ ነው፣ የትውልድ ቀንዎን ፈጽሞ አይደለም። እባክዎ በታማኝነት ይመልሱ፦ የድጋፍ ቡድናችን ስሕተትን ማስተካከል ይችላል።

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: የሥልጠና ዶጆዎ ከደረጃ 1 ዶጆ {arg1}× በፍጥነት ያሠለጥናል።

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: መንደርዎ ሊቀመጥ አልቻለም ({arg1})። የመሣሪያ ማከማቻ ያስለቅቁ፣ ደህንነቱን ለመጠበቅም በቅንብሮች ውስጥ የቁጠባ ኮድ ይቅዱ።

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: መንደርዎ በአገልጋዩ ላይ ተቀምጧል፦ በሀብቶቹ፣ በሕንፃዎቹ፣ በሠራዊቱና በምርምሩ ላይ ያለ እያንዳንዱ ለውጥ እዚያ ይረጋገጣል፣ ስለዚህ ከዚህ መሣሪያ ጋር ሊጠፋ አይችልም። የሚያደርጉት ሲጫወቱ ይላካል፤ ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሆኑ ይጠብቅና እንደገና ሲገናኙ ይሄዳል።

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: መንደርዎ አሁን በአገልጋዩ ላይ ነው። {arg1} ካረጋገጥነው ግዢ ጋር ሊዛመድ ስላልቻለ ለግምገማ ተይዟል፦ ከቅንብሮች ድጋፍን ያግኙ። የቀድሞ መንደርዎ እንደ ምትኬ ተቀምጧል።

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: መንደርዎ ተቀምጧል፣ እርስዎ በሌሉበትም ባለሙያዎችዎ መሥራታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ።

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: መንደርዎ ምሽጉ በእርግጥ ሊኖረው የሚችል መንደር ከሆነ፣ እንዳለ ወደ አገልጋዩ ይዛወራል። ከዚያ በኋላ እያንዳንዱ ለውጥ እዚያ ይረጋገጣል፣ መግቢያ በማገናኘትም በሌሎች መሣሪያዎች ላይ ሊጫወቱት ይችላሉ።

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: መንደርዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ በራስ-ሰር ይቀመጣል። ወደ ሌላ መሣሪያ ለማዛወር እዚህ የቁጠባ ኮድ ይቅዱና እዚያ ይጫኑት።

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: መንደርዎ በሌላ ትር ወይም መስኮት ውስጥ ተከፍቷል፣ ሊያስቀምጠው የሚችለውም አንዱ ብቻ ነው። እድገትዎ እዚያ ደህና ነው።

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.
ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.text: መንደርዎ በአዲስ የKagemura ስሪት ስለተቀመጠ ይህ ስሪት ሊከፍተው አይችልም። ደህና ነው፣ አልተቀየረም።

ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.en: Your war base now matches your village.
ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.text: የጦር መንደርዎ አሁን ከመንደርዎ ጋር ይዛመዳል።

extra.53d75daa54.en: There is no free space for that building.

extra.a0ce7f563a.en: Towers in a wide ring cover each other: jam one, smoke your squad as it reaches the next, break in through the gap.
extra.a0ce7f563a.text: በሰፊ ቀለበት የተደረደሩ ማማዎች እርስ በርሳቸው ይሸፋፈናሉ፦ አንዱን ያሽመድምዱ፣ ቡድንዎ ቀጣዩ ጋር ሲደርስ ጭስ ይጣሉበት፣ በክፍተቱም ሰብረው ይግቡ።

extra.1abbbc94b0.en: Two closed walls: Saboteurs and Tunnel Runners slip in, Guardians break through.
extra.1abbbc94b0.text: ሁለት የተዘጉ ግንቦች፦ አሻጥረኞችና የዋሻ ሯጮች ሾልከው ይገባሉ፣ ጠባቂዎች ሰብረው ያልፋሉ።

extra.4797c296e4.en: Firework Mortars guard the centre: jam them before the main force arrives, and spread out.
extra.4797c296e4.text: የርችት መድፎች መሃሉን ይጠብቃሉ፦ ዋናው ኃይል ከመድረሱ በፊት ያሽመድምዷቸው፣ ተበታተኑም።

extra.8e339fb4f5.en: Two gates funnel warriors onto hidden traps: choose a gate, or go over the wall.
extra.8e339fb4f5.text: ሁለት በሮች ተዋጊዎችን ወደ ተደበቁ ወጥመዶች ያስገባሉ፦ አንድ በር ይምረጡ፣ ወይም ግንቡን ዘለው ይለፉ።

extra.ab7daf1525.en: Buildings spread wide with no walls: fast Shinobi and Tunnel Runners clear it quickly.
extra.ab7daf1525.text: ሕንፃዎች ያለ ግንብ በሰፊው ተበትነዋል፦ ፈጣን ሺኖቢዎችና የዋሻ ሯጮች በፍጥነት ያጸዱታል።
